name: Sikadur®-31 CF Normal

breadcrumb.name: Epoxy Repair Mortars and Rigid Bonding

summary: Sikadur®-31 CF Normal is a moisture tolerant, thixotropic, structural 2-component adhesive and repair mortar, based on a combination of epoxy resins and special fillers, designed for use at temperatures between +10 °C and +30 °C.
metaDescription: Sikadur®-31 CF Normal is a moisture tolerant, thixotropic, structural 2-component adhesive and repair mortar, based on a combination of epoxy resins and special fillers, designed for use at temperatures between +10 °C and +30 °C.
attributes: Very good adhesion to most construction materials
Thixotropic: non-sag in vertical and overhead applications
High initial and ultimate mechanical strength
Impermeable to liquids and water vapour
usage: As a structural adhesive and mortar for:

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Adhesive for structural bonding tested according to EN 1504-4, provided with the CE-mark
AS/NZS 4020:2018 Potable Water Approved

items.label: Composition
items.text: Epoxy resin

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 24 months from date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Density
items.text: 1.90 + 0.1 kg/l (components A+B mixed) (at +23°C) (evacuated)

items.label: Compressive strength
items.text:
Curing time | Curing temperature
+10 °C | +23 °C | +30 °C
1 day | ~30 N/mm2 | ~50N/mm2 | ~55 N/mm2
3 days | ~45 N/mm2 | ~60 N/mm2 | ~65 N/mm2
7 days | ~55 N/mm2 | ~65 N/mm2 | ~65 N/mm2

items.label: Modulus of elasticity in compression
items.text: ~ 4,600 N/mm2 (14 days at +23 °C) | (ASTM D695)

items.label: Tensile strength in flexure
items.text:
Curing time | Curing temperature
+10 °C | +23 °C | +30 °C
1 day | ~14 N/mm2 | ~25 N/mm2 | ~25 N/mm2
2 days | ~25 N/mm2 | ~30 N/mm2 | ~30 N/mm2
7 days | ~30 N/mm2 | ~35 N/mm2 | ~35 N/mm2

items.label: Tensile strength
items.text:
Curing time | Curing temperature
+10 °C | +23 °C | +30 °C
1 day | ~4 N/mm2 | ~8 N/mm2 | ~12 N/mm2
3 days | ~12 N/mm2 | ~20 N/mm2 | ~20 N/mm2
7 days | ~17 N/mm2 | ~21 N/mm2 | ~22 N/mm2

items.label: Tensile adhesion strength
items.text:
Curing time | Substrate | Curing temperature | Adhesion strength
1 day | Concrete dry | +10 °C | > 4 N/mm2 *
1 day | Concrete moist | +10 °C | > 4 N/mm2 *
1 day | Steel | +10 °C | ~8 N/mm2
3 days | Steel | +10 °C | ~12 N/mm2
3 days | Steel | +23 °C | ~13 N/mm2
3 days | Steel | +30 °C | ~15 N/mm2
*100% concrete failure

items.label: Shrinkage
items.text: Hardens without shrinkage.

items.label: Coefficient of thermal expansion
items.text: 5.9 x 10−5 per °C (Temperature range +23 °C − +60 °C) | (EN 1770)

items.label: Heat deflection temperature
items.text:
Curing time | Curing temperature | HDT
7 days | +23°C | +49°C
(thickness 10 mm)

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text:
Component A : component B = 2 : 1 by weight or volume
When using multiple units, one after the other. Do not mix the following unit until the previous one has been used in order to avoid a reduction in handling time.

items.label: Layer thickness
items.text: 2 mm min. / 30 mm max.

items.label: Sag flow
items.text: On vertical surfaces it is non-sag up to 15 mm thickness. | (EN 1799)

items.label: Material temperature
items.text: Sikadur®-31 CF Normal must be applied at temperatures between +10 °C and +30 °C

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3 °C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +30 °C max.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: Substrate must be dry or mat damp (no standing water). Brush the adhesive well into the substrate.

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
Temperature | Potlife* | Open time
+10 °C | ~ 145 minutes | —
+23 °C | ~ 55 minutes | —
+30 °C | ~ 35 minutes | ~ 50 minutes
*200 g
The potlife begins when the resin and hardener are mixed. It is shorter at high temperatures and longer at low temperatures. The greater the quantity mixed, the shorter the potlife. To obtain longer workability at high temperatures, the mixed adhesive may be divided into portions. Another method is to chill components A+B before mixing them (not below +5 °C).

items.label: Consumption
items.text: The consumption of Sikadur®-31 CF Normal is ~ 1.9 kg/m2 per mm of thickness.

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Mortar and concrete must be older than 28 days (depends on minimal requirement of strengths). Verify the substrate strength (concrete, masonry, natural stone). The substrate surface (all types) must be clean, dry or mat damp (no standing water) and free from contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, existing surface treatments and coatings etc.. Steel substrates must be de-rusted similar to Sa 2.5. The substrate must be sound and all loose particles must be removed.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Concrete, mortar, stone, bricks: Substrates must be sound, dry or mat damp (no standing water), clean and free from laitance, ice, standing water, grease, oils, old surface treatments or coatings and all loose or friable particles must be removed to achieve a laitance and contaminant free, open textured surface. Steel: Must be cleaned and prepared thoroughly to an acceptable quality i.e. by blast cleaning and vacuum. Avoid dew point conditions.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Pre-batched units: Mix components A+B together for at least 3 minutes with a mixing spindle attached to a slow speed electric drill (max. 300 rpm) until the material becomes smooth in consistency and a uniform grey colour. Avoid aeration while mixing. Then, pour the whole mix into a clean container and stir again for approx. 1 more minute at low speed to keep air entrapment at a minimum. Mix only that quantity which can be used within its potlife.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Sika® Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.
